title: Diesel price rises by Rs1.91 per litre, petrol unchanged - Investify
text:
Diesel price rises by Rs1.91 per litre, petrol unchanged | Mettis Global | Investify Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Diesel price rises by Rs1.91 per litre, petrol unchanged
 Mettis Global • 24 Oct 2026, 9:54 AM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f Mettis Global reported on October 24, 2026 that the government raised the ex-depot rate for High-Speed Diesel (HSD) by Rs1.91 per litre. The revised diesel price is Rs393.66 per litre, compared with Rs391.75 previously. Petrol, also described as Motor Spirit, remains at Rs377.71 per litre, with the new rates applying from October 24 to October 26, 2026.
 The Ministry of Energy’s Petroleum Division made the revision under the federal petroleum pricing mechanism, with OGRA updating the ex-depot rates. The report attributes the adjustment to international market factors, including movements in Platts rates, premiums and incidentals. Diesel’s increase alongside an unchanged petrol rate creates different near-term price movements across the two main fuels, making the notification relevant to fuel-market participants and consumers.
 At a glance
 Diesel increased by Rs1.91 per litre to Rs393.66.
 Petrol stayed at Rs377.71 per litre.
 The revised rates apply from October 24 to October 26, 2026.
 Why it matters
 The revised diesel and petrol rates are relevant to investors tracking Pakistan’s oil marketing sector and fuel prices.
